title: Port the Step 7 randomization onto the src package layout
summary: Merging main moves the Step 7 work from locomotion/ to src/locomotion/. The surrogate keeps --randomization none|table2_v1 in training and evaluation, and the AMP adapter in amp/amp.py fills the critic's friction and push slots from the environment. The randomized motor law moves to randomization.motor_force over the unchanged robots/rs05.py, so the native runtime sources keep their identity. The table2_v1 declaration hash stays 533c9a4161a67867ffd5ab32a5dc480d2f73d78dc1b27fcdde95ea219f7d71c0. On main's rewritten surrogate, none still reproduces the pre-change trajectory step7_baseline_20261013_001 bit for bit, including the selected reset and the event counters. The declaration section moves from docs/TRAINING.md to the implementation guide, and TRAINING.md names the hash. The source archive binds the pre-move Step 7 paths to 36107dc1.
next: Train two surrogate runs from seed 20260917, none against table2_v1 for 2000 updates, add the 27-cell fixed-condition sweep and bring both to the first #67 review, which freezes the ranges and push schedule before any native code.
reason: A layout port of CPU design code: no native run, admission or accepted capability changes.
